insight: Hit a $1.15B valuation in Feb 2026 on a $100M Series B led by Accel; its agents are used by ~30% of the top 25 US accounting firms.
name: Basis
tagline: Autonomous AI agents built for accounting firms.
description: Basis builds AI agents purpose-built for accountants that execute complex accounting workflows end-to-end and return finished output ready for review. It integrates with existing ledgers and systems to handle tax, audit, advisory, and client-accounting tasks, adapting to each firm's processes rather than relying on rigid rules.
edge: Runs multi-step tax, audit, and advisory workflows end-to-end and returns review-ready output — beyond chat or single-task assistants.
